description_en: Queries the details of a device registration policy within the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号下设备注册策略详情
name: GetRegistrationPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device registration policy. Valid values are obtained from the following sources:
[ListRegistrationPolicies](~~ListRegistrationPolicies~~): Queries device registration policies in batches.
[GetRegistrationPolicy](~~GetRegistrationPolicy~~): Queries the details of a device registration policy.
[CreateRegistrationPolicy](~~CreateRegistrationPolicy~~): Creates a device registration policy.
[UpdateRegistrationPolicy](~~UpdateRegistrationPolicy~~): Updates a device registration policy
parameters.help_zh:
设备注册策略ID。取值来源：
[ListRegistrationPolicies](~~ListRegistrationPolicies~~)：批量查询设备注册策略。
[GetRegistrationPolicy](~~GetRegistrationPolicy~~)：查询设备注册策略详情。
[CreateRegistrationPolicy](~~CreateRegistrationPolicy~~)：创建设备注册策略。
[UpdateRegistrationPolicy](~~UpdateRegistrationPolicy~~)：更新设备注册策略
parameters.name: policy_id

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the device registration policy was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 设备注册策略创建时间

Description.description_en: The description of the device registration policy
Description.example: 这是一条设备注册策略。

LimitDetail.description_en: The list of limit details of the device registration policy
LimitDetail.description_zh: 设备注册策略限制详情列表

items.description_en: The list of limit details of the device registration policy
items.description_zh: 设备注册策略限制详情列表

DeviceBelong.description_en:
The ownership of the device. Valid values:
Company: company-owned device.
Personal: personal device
DeviceBelong.description_zh:
设备归属。取值：
Company：公司设备。
Personal：个人设备

All.description_en: The total device registration limit. This parameter is valid when the device registration limit type is LimitAll
All.description_zh: 设备注册限制总数。当设备注册限制类型为LimitAll时，该字段的值有效

Mobile.description_en: The number of mobile logins allowed by the device registration limit. This parameter is valid when the device registration limit type is LimitDiff
Mobile.description_zh: 设备注册限制移动端登录数量。当设备注册限制类型为LimitDiff时，该字段的值有效

PC.description_en: The number of PC logins allowed by the device registration limit. This parameter is valid when the device registration limit type is LimitDiff
PC.description_zh: 设备注册限制PC端登录数量。当设备注册限制类型为LimitDiff时，该字段的值有效

LimitType.description_en:
The type of the device registration limit. Valid values:
Unlimited: no limit.
LimitAll: limit by total count.
LimitDiff: limit by terminal category
LimitType.description_zh:
设备注册限制类型。取值：
Unlimited：不限制。
LimitAll：按照总数限制。
LimitDiff：按照终端分类限制

MatchMode.description_en:
The match mode of the policy. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: associated with all users.
UserGroupNormal: associated with specific user groups
MatchMode.description_zh:
策略匹配目标类型。取值：
UserGroupAll：关联全体用户。
UserGroupNormal：关联部分用户组

Name.description_en: The name of the device registration policy

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the device registration policy

Priority.description_en: The priority of the device registration policy. The value 0 indicates the highest priority, and the value 99 indicates the lowest priority
Priority.description_zh: 设备注册策略优先级。数字0表示优先级最高，数字99表示优先级最低

Status.description_en:
The status of the device registration policy. Valid values:
Enabled: enabled.
Disabled: disabled
Status.description_zh:
设备注册策略状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

UserGroupIds.description_en: The IDs of the user groups associated with the device registration policy. This parameter is valid when the match mode of the policy is UserGroupNormal
UserGroupIds.description_zh: 设备注册策略，用户组ID集合。当策略匹配目标类型为UserGroupNormal时，该字段有值

items.description_en: The ID of a user group associated with the device registration policy when the match mode of the policy is UserGroupNormal
items.description_zh: 设备注册策略，策略匹配目标类型为UserGroupNormal时的用户组ID

Whitelist.description_en: The list of whitelisted users in the device registration policy
Whitelist.description_zh: 设备注册策略白名单用户列表

items.description_en: A whitelisted user in the device registration policy
items.description_zh: 设备注册策略白名单用户
